title: CRP Frontmatter
description: Validates the YAML frontmatter of an i-SASE Clarification Request Packet (CRP). A CRP is raised when execution encounters ambiguity, conflict, or other issues requiring human clarification.

schema.description: Schema identifier for the CRP artifact type.

id.description: Unique 12-character hex identifier for the CRP.

bp.description: Identifier of the BriefingPack this CRP is associated with.

urgency.description: How urgently a response is needed. 'blocking' halts execution until resolved.

category.description: Classification of the issue that triggered this CRP.

status.description: Current resolution status of the CRP.

routed-to.description: Team member this CRP is routed to
